## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A fifteen-fascicle early-Qīng commentary on **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3), 596–667) *Sìfēnlǜ shānbǔ suíjī jiémó* 四分律刪補隨機羯磨 ([KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019)) by **Jiànyuè Dútǐ** 見月讀體 ([讀體](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AE%80%E9%AB%94), 1601–1679), the principal early-Qīng *Bǎohuáshān* 寶華山 Vinaya-school revivalist. *Zuòchí* 作持 ("rules of doing") indicates the *karman* / regulatory side of *vinaya* (paired with *zhǐchí* 止持, the rules of non-doing); *xùshì* 續釋 ("continued commentary") signals Dútǐ's editorial intent to revive the long-dormant Sòng *zuòchí* commentary tradition.

**Abstract**

The *Xùshì* is the principal **early-Qīng Bǎohuáshān** *zuòchí* commentary and the practical complement to Dìngān Déjī's later *Píní guānyào* ([KR6k0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0152)) on the *zhǐchí* side. With its preface dated 1665 it is the earliest of the great Bǎohuáshān Vinaya works of the Kāngxī era and reflects Dútǐ's twenty-year recovery of Dàoxuān's karman tradition under conditions where (as Dútǐ explicitly notes in the preface) the *zuòchí* portion of the Vinaya had received "no expounder for several hundred years." The work supplies *guǎngqí shìfǎ shìqí yǐnwēi* 廣其事法釋其隱微 ("amplifying the affairs and rules, glossing the subtle and hidden") on each *jiémó* formula of the canonical *Suíjī jiémó*. The text is an indispensable witness to early-Qīng Vinaya pedagogy at its most institutionally consequential moment — the founding generation of the Bǎohuáshān Vinaya revival.
